params.name: market
params.description: Energy Market or both (day-ahead, real-time, or both).

params.name: day
params.description: The operating day of the data.

params.name: participantName
params.description: The NERC ID of asset owner specified in the path for a collection resource.

params.name: pnode
params.description: Required parameter to specify the name of a pricing node for the requested data.

params.name: scheduleId
params.description: List of integers used to specify one or more scheduleId to be queried.

params.name: scheduleType
params.description: Specifies the assignment type to be queried or all if no query parameter is provided. Valid values are CostSchedule, ReferencePrice, or RSG.

items.docs: Returns the collection of Independant Market Monitor (IMM) resource assignments by pnode location for the day for a particular participant's resources. Message format differs by offerType property which can be one of the following values; - genImmOffer - dirImmOffer - drr1ImmOffer - drr2ImmOffer - earImmOffer - serImmOffer - esrImmOffer
